thresholds_mT.source: TI DRV5033 datasheet SLIS151, AJ option, -40..125 °C

note: Offsets are magnet centre to Hall centre along the axis. U1 sits HALL_LEAD behind the magnet's retract end position, U2 HALL_LEAD in front of its extend end position. The same unit repeats its stop point; the spread is unit-to-unit. Steel leadscrew and motor not modelled.
